not: En fazla 6 klip, yalnızca yapay zekâ görsellerinden (gerçek fotoğraf animasyona sokulmaz). yilan_yakin ve eski ahir_sabah çıkarıldı. Yılan kliplerinde (duvar_yilan, yilan_fare): bacak belirmesi, göz kırpma, dil dışında ağız hareketi, yılanın fareye/ineğe temas etmesi görülürse o kısım kırpılır. Yılan olmayan kliplerin isteminde 'snake' kelimesi geçmez. Her klipten 5 kare (0,5-4,9 sn) incelenir. 6 klip x 0,35 $ = 2,1 $. Shorts dosyası (shorts.json) hâlâ yilan_yakin ve s1 klibini kullanıyor; yeniden kurulmalı.

klipler.istem: The morning mist drifts slowly over the hills, the grass and flowers sway gently in the breeze, smoke rises softly from the chimney, leaves flutter a little. Camera static, slow natural motion only, no people and no animals appear. Storybook watercolor style preserved.

The calf suckles gently with small head bumps and a wagging tail while the cow chews calmly and turns her head to lick the calf once. Camera static, gentle natural motion only, cow four legs and calf four legs, no extra legs, nothing new appears. Storybook watercolor style preserved.
klipler.not: RET (23 Kas): ikinci inek başı gibi görünen hareket; kullanılmıyor

klipler.istem: The snake slowly glides a short way along the foot of the stone wall, its body flowing smoothly, lifts its head a little and flicks its tongue once or twice, the grass sways gently. Camera static, slow natural motion only. The snake stays limbless, no legs appear, the eyes stay round and dot-like, no blinking, no new animals appear. Storybook watercolor style preserved.

The snake glides very slowly along the wall toward the hole, the tongue flicks, the little mouse peeks out, twitches its whiskers and stays where it is, straw moves slightly. Camera static, slow natural motion only, the snake stays limbless without legs, eyes stay round, the mouse is not caught or hurt, no new animals appear. Storybook watercolor style preserved.

Golden evening light slowly shifts, the cow flicks an ear, the calf wags its tail, window light glows warmer, grass sways gently. Camera static, gentle natural motion only, no new animals appear, animals keep correct limbs. Storybook watercolor style preserved.
